text: PAWL-005 AC3 requires the attestation to record, per claim, the asserted checks, the resolved coverage status, the anchor status and the human-attention verdict. Its named test TestAttestationShape asserts only coverage. Dropping Anchor (attest.go:55), Asserted (58) or NeedsHuman (63) leaves the whole suite green — verified as mutations M27, M28, M29. Three of the four fields the criterion names are unasserted.
